newsitem.title: USA: USA Waste to buy Allied Waste Canadian assets.
newsitem.headline: USA Waste to buy Allied Waste Canadian assets.

text.p: USA Waste Services Inc said Thursday it has executed a definitive agreement to acquire all the Canadian solid waste assets of Allied Waste Industries Inc for about US$518 million.
Allied acquired these assets from Laidlaw Inc in December 1996, in connection with their purchase of all Laidlaw's solid waste business in North America, a statement from USA Waste said.

The closing of the transaction, estimated to occur prior to the end of the first quarter of 1997, is subject to Canadian regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions, the statement said.

The assets being acquired by USA Waste generate about US$270 million a year in revenues and include 7 landfills, 41 collection operations and 8 transfer stations in the provinces of Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, Ontario, Quebec and Saskatchewan, USA Waste said.
USA Waste said the transaction is expected to be accretive to 1997 earnings and will significantly expand its asset base and market presence in Canada.
